{{Quote|My own child, this is.|Kycina, referring to her infant son|<ref name="Plagueis" />}}
'''Kycina''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], as well as his brothers [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Feral/Legends|Feral]]. She was affiliated with the [[Witches of Dathomir]], a cult of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] beings led by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]. Shortly after Maul's birth, Kycina persuaded [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] to take her son away from Dathomir, thus sparing him from a life of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] as a [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Maul, he is called.''"<br />"''Befitting the power you divine in him.|Kycina and Darth Sidious|<ref name="Plagueis" />}}
[[File:Darth_Maul_profile.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Maul, son of Kycina, was a powerful asset to the [[Order of the Sith Lords]].]]
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] Kycina was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of two [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] infants, one of whom was named [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]]. By tradition on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], the [[Maul's father|father]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] shortly after Maul's conception. Kycina believed that [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], the leader of the [[Witches of Dathomir]], only knew of [[Savage Opress/Legends|one]] of the two brothers. Thus she kept Maul's existence a secret while waiting for a chance to spirit him away from Dathomir. By doing so, she hoped to save Maul from becoming one of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]], a clan of Zabraks trained to serve the Nightsisters as [[warrior]]s and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

Kycina's opportunity came less than a year after young Maul's [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] persona of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] Palpatine, visited Dathomir out of interest in its relation to Sith history. While exploring [[Blue Desert City]], Sidious was approached by Maul's mother. Kycina implored the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to take her son from her and raise him away from Dathomir, far from Talzin's reach. Though initially reluctant to accept her offer, Sidious was ultimately persuaded by Maul's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|strong sensitivity]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

Unsure of what to do with his new charge, Sidious approached his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], with an offer: to [[Sith training|train]] Maul in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Although such an action technically violated the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], which allowed for only two Sith Lords to exist at any given time, Plagueis granted his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] permission to proceed with Maul's indoctrination. However, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] was also clear that the Zabrak was to be an [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] rather than a fully trained Sith Lord. Although Darth Sidious agreed, he did begin Maul's training in secret when his own master was absent and healing from an assassination attempt. Under Sidious' tutelage&mdash;and Plagueis' observation&mdash;Kycina's son grew up to become Darth Maul, a Sith [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] deeply immersed in the dark side.<ref name="Plagueis" />

In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], [[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]] learned of Kycina's betrayal, and in turn had her locked away and later punished.<ref name="Restraint" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in 21 BBY,<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref> her other son Savage Opress<ref name="Restraint" /> became secretly apprenticed to the Nightsister [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who sought to use the powerful Dathomirian pawn to exact revenge on her former master and betrayer, [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]]. As a sign of his immersion in the dark side of the Force at the behest of Ventress, Opress committed fratricide by murdering his brother [[Feral/Legends|Feral]].<ref name="Monster" /> After reuniting with Darth Maul in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> the two surviving sons of Kycina quickly established themselves as a threat to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>

By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], her son [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] would die on [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] at the hands of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the very man who she gave Maul to.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Take him. Save him.|Kycina, pleading with Sidious on her son's behalf|<ref name="Plagueis" />}}
The Nightsister who gave birth to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] deeply cared for her son. While Kycina's other offspring was fated to serve Mother Talzin as a Nightbrother, she desperately wanted to give Maul a chance to live a different life; a life of freedom from an entire clan that was bred and raised for slavery to the Witches of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Hence, she was willing to be forever parted from her son, so long as it meant that he would be taken away from Dathomir.<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kycina was first introduced as the mother of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="Plagueis" /> She was first identified as "Kycina" in the short story ''[[Restraint]]'', which also confirms her status as the mother of [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Feral/Legends|Feral]].<ref name="Restraint" />

However, the [[2014]] comic [[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir'' 3]], based on unproduced scripts from ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', revealed that Talzin is Maul's mother.<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Three">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]]</ref>
